directive.thread_id: cloud job 2026-11-06: route owner port, the owner of a person's connected accounts
directive.quote: Create tools/connections/ in the Workshop with tool:list-connections, ported one to one from the old owner and from what those engine files do for listing, over the records or door operations the connections actually live in.

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion 4ffa1dc4a2 (Retire old trillion's Worker and everything only it reached) already removed src/held-values.mjs from its main line

preserve: one row a connection, as the listing shows it (old connectionSummaryOf's fields), in connection id order
from the summary rows once every connection has one, from the facts until then: a connection is never left out of the list
a disconnected connection stays listed with can_send false
no value ever leaves: a row is the summary's own fields, never a record spread whole
allowed_deltas: the summary rows are the person's own `connection` records read through the records door, not the store's connection_summaries table

the facts of a connection with no record are what the account files door's held_connections says from the vault's names (its id and the fields it holds), made into a row by the old connectionSummaryOf (imported from tools/find-and-keep-my-connections, never copied); its status, connected_at, check and connected_by are not known there and are left out
the service's name for such a row comes from its descriptor in tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/records.json, as the old connect wrote it into the facts
a vault that cannot be read fails the list rather than answering it empty
banned_substitutions: a status, check or connection time said for a connection whose facts nobody kept
an empty list for a vault that could not be read

test_refs: tools/connections/test/list-connections.test.mjs a connection is listed by its id with can_send, and only the connection records and the held names are read
tools/connections/test/list-connections.test.mjs a check the service refused, and a disconnect, leave the connection listed with can_send false
tools/connections/test/list-connections.test.mjs until every held connection has its row the list answers from the facts: what the held names say, the rest unknown
